reviews.comment: Great for families. Kids loved the pool. Parking was tight and expensive though. Call me on (403) 555-0123 if you want details.
The bison short rib was the best meal of our trip. Cozy fireplace and attentive service. Book ahead on weekends.
Food was good but slow on a busy Saturday. We waited an hour for mains. Reservation code RES-77812 for reference.
Massage was excellent and the quiet room overlooking the valley was a highlight. Clean and calm.
Change rooms were not clean and there were not enough lockers on a Sunday afternoon.
